profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: I am looking for employment that will allow me me to expand upon my experience in testing to include work in development allowing me to showcase my skills and creativity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Triage issues and and identify solutions for problems found in both upper and lower environments
Develop Back-end code in both Ruby on Rails and Java that fits in a complex workflow
Write SQL queries to help identify data discrepancies 
Develop solutions in ReactJS

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test
positions.description:
● Preform manual test validating stories against acceptance criteria
● Write automated API test using core Java and RestAssured within the Cucumber Framework
● Write automated UI test using Selenium w/ Serenity wrapper
● Develop Database Scripts to validate data and compare against inputted data
● Develop a program to train a team of manual testers the basics of Java development allowing them to write automated Selenium test.
● Assist BA with technical analysis and support team in creating stories that will meet the Product Owners Expectations
● Perform code reviews against test code to make sure it address useful test cases and meets high coding standards.
● Create Test scenarios based on BDD methodology
● Configure Jenkins job to run Cucumber Features with Gradle. 
● Report and triage bugs, providing fixes and remediation plans
● Write utility classes to simplify testing methods 
● Regularly evaluate code to find opportunities to refactor and simplify framework
● Set up business layer of Java Web Project 
● Work in a fast pace Agile/Scrum environment

positions.title: Retention Mentor
positions.description: Work with a small group of Freshman students and providing guidance navigating the transition to college, prepare topics for group meetings, provide one-on-one support identifying and helping to provide solutions to problems they are facing

positions.title: Tutor and Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Provide in-class assistance to a first-year computer science class
Help students design algorithms to solve C++ programs
Assist students with navigating the Windows 8 environment

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Using the Distributed Data Framework (DDF) to monitor files for new files from multiple computers.
Develop a browser based application to search and view data in the DDF 
Use Javascript to create an application data returned from the DDF onto a Cesium map

positions.title: Data Management Intern
positions.description:
Analyzed and identify important data requirements for upcoming Data Store using Excel
Created written documentation of meetings with customers, to identify needs and problems
Designed visuals to use for presentation of the benefits and outcomes for the project

Invited to work again during break from December 2013- January 2014 (rougly 5 weeks)

company.name: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
•	Provide in class assistance to two  introductory computer science classes
•	Provide group and individual assistance with computer science programs

positions.title: Lab Technical Assistant
positions.description:
Maintain an orderly environment.
Perform office task to ensure efficiency of lab.
Assist others in development and execution of C++ programs.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Research of various companies and competitors
Provided assistance in increasing the accuracy of mined data from the internet
Introduced and began basic work in the Linux (Ubuntu) OS
Worked in the Jira database system
June 2011-August 2011
